INTRODUCING HOMEVIEW

HomeView helps you understand what’s happening in your home and how to keep it healthy and comfortable.

If environmental sensors have been installed in your home by iOpt and your housing provider, this app lets you see simple, easy-to-understand information about your living conditions. You’ll also get helpful guidance on small things that can make a positive difference.

WHAT YOU CAN DO WITH HOMEVIEW

Understand your home
- See current conditions in your home in a clear, simple view
- Check how your home has been doing over the last 1, 7, or 30 days
- Easy-to-read visuals that show when things are looking good or need attention

Get helpful advice
- Simple hints and tips to help keep your home healthier
- Clear guidance if a room may need a bit of extra attention
- Support that helps you spot issues early


Don't hesitate to get in touch with your housing provider to find out more about the devices installed into your home.
